name: Christmas Blizzard
source:
Mia is driving to her family’s Christmas dinner when suddenly her car stalls, leaving her stranded in the middle of a blizzard! She still has a long way to go to reach Norwood, where her family lives, but for now she's stuck in the forest. She'll have to figure out how to survive this icy snowstorm and get to dinner in one piece.

[From [url=https://neonx-studio.itch.io/christmas-blizzard]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
米娅正开车去参加家人的圣诞晚宴，突然她的车熄火了，让她被困在暴风雪中！她还有很长的路要走才能到达她家人居住的诺伍德，但现在她被困在森林里。她必须想办法如何度过这场冰冷的暴风雪并全身心地吃晚饭。

[来自[url=https://neonx-studio.itch.io/christmas-blizzard]itch.io[/url]]
